# Crate Root Skeleton Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Create `src/lib.rs` with the complete module tree, lint configuration, feature-gated backends, and top-level re-exports so that `cargo check` (with all feature combinations) and `cargo doc --no-deps` succeed.

**Architecture:** Root module declares 22 public modules, 2 internal modules (`private`, `dispatch`), 2 conditional backend modules (`simd`, `parallel` behind feature gates), and 1 prelude module. Modules that later grow subfiles must start as directory modules (`src/<module>/mod.rs`) now so later waves do not hit Rust's file-vs-directory module conflict. Convenience re-exports expose `prelude::*` and `XenonError` at the crate root.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024

**Design Docs:** `design/01-architecture.md` §8 (lib.rs spec), §6 (feature gate matrix), §7 (prelude exports); `design/00-coding.md` §3.2 (rustfmt config), §7.1 (lint baseline)

**Prerequisites:** W1T1 (Cargo.toml) must be complete.

---

### Task 1: Create module stub files

Empty stub files are needed for every module declaration in `lib.rs` so that `cargo check` can resolve all module paths. The stub layout must already match later waves: modules expanded in future tasks use `src/<module>/mod.rs`, while modules that remain single-file stay flat.

**Files:**
- Create: 26 empty module stub files under `src/`
- Create: `src/error.rs` with minimal `XenonError` placeholder

- [ ] **Step 1: Create all empty module stub files with the final module layout**

Run:
```bash
mkdir -p src/dimension src/element src/complex src/storage src/layout src/tensor src/iter src/math src/overload src/matrix src/util src/set src/broadcast src/reduction src/shape src/index src/construct src/convert src/format src/ffi src/workspace src/simd src/parallel

# Internal single-file modules
touch src/private.rs src/dispatch.rs

# Public directory modules that expand in later waves
touch src/dimension/mod.rs src/element/mod.rs src/complex/mod.rs
touch src/storage/mod.rs src/layout/mod.rs src/tensor/mod.rs src/iter/mod.rs
touch src/math/mod.rs src/overload/mod.rs src/matrix/mod.rs src/util/mod.rs
touch src/set/mod.rs src/broadcast/mod.rs src/reduction/mod.rs src/shape/mod.rs
touch src/index/mod.rs src/construct/mod.rs src/convert/mod.rs src/format/mod.rs
touch src/ffi/mod.rs src/workspace/mod.rs

# Conditional backend modules (feature-gated, only compiled when enabled)
touch src/simd/mod.rs src/parallel/mod.rs

# Prelude stays single-file
touch src/prelude.rs
```
Expected: 26 empty module stub files created under `src/` with no flat-vs-directory conflicts against later waves

Verify:
```bash
python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; files = [p for p in Path('src').rglob('*.rs') if p.name != 'error.rs']; print(len(files))"
```
Expected: `26`

### Task 2: Create lib.rs

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib.rs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the complete lib.rs**

Create `src/lib.rs` with the following content (sourced from `design/01-architecture.md` §8):

```rust
//! # Xenon
//!
//! A Rust N-dimensional array library for scientific computing.

#![cfg_attr(docsrs, feature(doc_cfg))]
#![warn(missing_docs)]
#![warn(missing_debug_implementations)]
#![warn(rust_2024_compatibility)]
#![warn(unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn)]
#![warn(clippy::unwrap_used)]

// Internal modules
mod private;
mod dispatch;

// Public modules
pub mod error;
pub mod dimension;
pub mod element;
pub mod complex;
pub mod storage;
pub mod layout;
pub mod tensor;
pub mod iter;
pub mod math;
pub mod overload;
pub mod matrix;
pub mod util;
pub mod set;
pub mod broadcast;
pub mod reduction;
pub mod shape;
pub mod index;
pub mod construct;
pub mod convert;
pub mod format;
pub mod ffi;
pub mod workspace;

// Conditional backend modules
#[cfg(feature = "simd")]
#[cfg_attr(docsrs, doc(cfg(feature = "simd")))]
pub(crate) mod simd;

#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
#[cfg_attr(docsrs, doc(cfg(feature = "parallel")))]
pub(crate) mod parallel;

// Prelude
pub mod prelude;

// Convenience re-exports
pub use prelude::*;
pub use error::XenonError;
```
